lesson.title: Lost for three days (Luke 2:41–52)
lesson.hook: twelve-year-old Jesus stays in the Temple and asks why they didn't know he'd be in his Father's house

title: three days
hook: a parent turns around, and the child isn't there.
cast: today: a Filipino mom and son in a Manila market.
